Print a summary of a multiScaleR fit

Source: R/print_methods.R
print.summary_multiScaleR.Rd

Prints the object returned by summary.multiScaleR(): the estimated scales with their intervals, the scale distances under both definitions, the fitted model, any warnings, and the follow-up recommendation.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'summary_multiScaleR'
print(x, dimension = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A summary_multiScaleR object from summary.multiScaleR().

dimension

Character, "2d" or "1d". Selects which distance table is printed first. The default, NULL, uses the definition stored in x; summaries saved before this choice existed print the 1D table first.

...

Ignored.

Value

Invisibly returns x.

See also

summary.multiScaleR(), kernel_dist() for the two distance definitions.

Examples

data(pts)
data(count_data)
hab <- terra::rast(system.file("extdata", "hab.tif",
                               package = "multiScaleR"))
inputs <- kernel_prep(pts = pts, raster_stack = hab, max_D = 250,
                      kernel = "gaussian", verbose = FALSE)
fit <- multiScale_optim(glm(y ~ hab, family = poisson, data = count_data),
                        inputs, verbose = FALSE)
s <- summary(fit)
print(s, dimension = "1d")   # line-based distances first
#>

#> multiScale_optim(fitted_mod = glm(y ~ hab, family = poisson, 
#>     data = count_data), kernel_inputs = inputs, verbose = FALSE)
